description: This is a test class for the Support utility in the com.anysoftkeyboard.addons package, containing unit tests for the createBackwardCompatibleStyleable method, verifying behavior with same package, different package, and no value scenarios.

classes.name: SupportTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing Support.createBackwardCompatibleStyleable method with various package scenarios.

methods.name: testSamePackageSameValues
methods.description: Tests that createBackwardCompatibleStyleable returns the same styleable array when the package is the same.

methods.name: testDifferentPackageDifferentValues
methods.description: Tests that createBackwardCompatibleStyleable correctly retrieves attribute identifiers from a different package and populates the SparseIntArray accordingly.

methods.name: testDifferentPackageNoValue
methods.description: Tests behavior when the remote resources do not provide attribute identifiers (getIdentifier returns 0).
